1.title: Proposal for White House Visitor Screening Center Advances
1.summary: A federal panel again paved the way for one of President Trump’s construction projects, even as it heard opposition to another proposal to fence in a park north of the White House.

2.title: Burning Man Draws an Older, Wealthier Crowd, Data Shows
2.summary: Last year, just one in ten festivalgoers was in their 20s, according to researchers. A decade ago, the same group represented nearly 30 percent of attendees.

3.title: Missouri Supreme Court Delivers Win for Democrats in Redistricting Case
3.summary: The court said a map redrawn to benefit Republicans could not be used in November. Voters will decide whether the new boundaries ever take effect.

4.title: Norway Seizes Russian Ship, Testing Moscow in the High Arctic
4.summary: Empowered by an international court order, Norway captured the vessel as part of a global effort to seize Russian assets. The Russians called it “piracy.”

5.title: ICE agent charged with lying about shooting Venezuelan man during crackdown
5.summary: The ICE officer faces federal charges related to the January shooting in Minnesota.

6.title: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
6.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.
